sql: WITH committed AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND status IN ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled')), snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp, quantity::numeric) AS qty FROM positions ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT 'A_live_open_by_cap_rule' AS what, 'distinct committed tickers' AS k, count(*)::text AS v FROM committed UNION ALL SELECT 'A_live_open_by_cap_rule', 'settled flat (excluded)', count(*)::text FROM committed c JOIN snap s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty IS NOT NULL AND abs(s.qty) <= 0.01 UNION ALL SELECT 'A_live_open_by_cap_rule', 'STILL OPEN = the capped number', count(*)::text FROM committed c LEFT JOIN snap s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty IS NULL OR abs(s.qty) > 0.01 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_no_snapshot_rows', 'committed tickers with NO position snapshot', count(*)::text FROM committed c LEFT JOIN snap s USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.market_ticker IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'C_twin_cap', 'Fmmsell10_pt4 paper open (cap 250)', count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2
